verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents an Auth0-to-Better-Auth migration guide that covers email/password "with proper hashing," social accounts and 2FA. It also lets you supply a custom password hashing function, so imported legacy hashes can still be verified. On the export side, users stay in your own database via database adapters, and community users report owning all their data and finding it easy to switch providers, but no export feature is documented. Missing for 10: a documented generic bulk-import API or tool beyond the Auth0-specific guide, a first-party user export capability, and hands-on corroboration of hash-preserving import/export.
